decision_summary: Approve the narrow three-entity Sequestered Replay and Policy-Gaming Detection design for implementation.
rationale: Visionary confirms the evaluation-integrity gap, Builder reuses calibration-report and judge trials, and Guardian requires evidenced blindness, explicit affordances, externalized transcript review, governance, privacy, and non-authority.
recommendation: Implement schema, verifier, example, fixtures, documentation, roadmap, and release evidence, then run full self-review and Council review.
